id: \bJames: These things are out of control! Who would have thought it would have this kind of side effect?
en: \bJames: These things are out of control! Who would have thought it would have this kind of side effect?
it: \bJames: Queste cose sono fuori controllo! Chi avrebbe mai detto che ci sarebbe stato un effetto collaterale del genere?

id: \bMeowth: Maybe a loud noise will get rid of them?
en: \bMeowth: Maybe a loud noise will get rid of them?
it: \bMeowth: Magari un rumore forte li farà scappare?

id: \rJessie: The mission is our priority, worry about the Venipede later.
en: \rJessie: The mission is our priority, worry about the Venipede later.
it: \rJessie: La missione ha la priorità, ai Venipede penseremo dopo.

id: \bJames: Looks like another problem came up!
en: \bJames: Looks like another problem came up!
it: \bJames: Sembra che sia saltato fuori un altro problema!

id: Team Rocket blasting off scared off the Venipede.
en: Team Rocket blasting off scared off the Venipede.
it: Il Team Rocket, spedito in orbita, ha messo in fuga i Venipede.
